'''Eagle Mountain Casino''' is an Indian tribal casino operated by the [[Tule River Indian Tribe of the Tule River Reservation]] in [[Porterville, California]], adjacent to the [[Porterville Municipal Airport]]. In 2020, it received approval to be moved from the reservation to free up water for residents.

==History==
The casino opened on June 1, 1996 in the [[Tule River Reservation]] in [[California]].

In October 2019, "the assistant secretary for the [[Bureau of Indian Affairs]] (BIA) signed a [[record of decision]] (ROD) and issued a secretarial determination giving the Tule Tribe its blessing to relocate Eagle Mt. Casino to a 40-acre site near the Porterville airport, 15 miles off reservation land," after determining that the proposed project was in the best interest of the tribe.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://thesungazette.com/article/business/2019/11/16/eagle-mountain-casino-nearly-off-the-reservation/ |title=Eagle Mountain Casino nearly off the reservation |date=Nov 16, 2019 |website=The Sun Gazette}}</ref> After the casino closed due to COVID-19 cases in Tulare County, on August 21, 2020, the casino reopened after a decision by the Tule River Tribal Council. The Forest Buffet stayed closed, and the Grizzly Food Court was re-opened for 24-hours a day with limited capacity. It had previously closed in July 2020, after re-opening in June.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://abc30.com/eagle-mountain-casino-porterville-opening-today-is-open/6381940/ |title=Eagle Mountain Casino Porterville Opening Today is Open |date=Aug 21, 2020|website=[[KFSN-TV|ABC30]]}}</ref>

On August 4, 2020, [[Gavin Newsom]] agreed to allow the relocation of the casino into Porterville. The new plan for a $180 million casino included 1,750 gaming machines and twice as many table games.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://thesungazette.com/article/news/2020/08/12/tule-tribe-casino-will-be-coming-down-the-mountain/ |title=Tule Tribe casino will be coming down the mountain |website=The Sun Gazette |date=August 12, 2020 }}</ref> It was approved by the Department of the Interior that December.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://kmph.com/news/local/department-of-interior-approves-the-relocation-of-eagle-mountain-casino |title=Eagle Mountain Casino receives approval for relocation |website=KMPH|date=December 8, 2020 |first=Tyler |last=Moyer }}</ref>

On April 6, 2021, Tule River Tribe broke ground on the new property for Eagle Mountain Casino,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://kmph.com/news/local/eagle-mountain-casino-breaking-ground-on-the-new-casino-after-25-years |title=Eagle Mountain Casino breaking ground on the new casino after 25 years |website=KMPH |date=April 6, 2021 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.kget.com/news/local-news/crews-break-ground-on-new-eagle-mountain-casino-in-porterville/ |title=Crews break ground on new Eagle Mountain Casino in Porterville |website=kget.com |date=April 6, 2021}}</ref> to be moved from the reservation to Porterville. It was set to open in fall 2022 on 40 acres near the Porterville Airport. The new development circumvents a [[water scarcity|water shortage]] that "hobbled on development on reservation land" for years. The move freed up water on the reservation for private residences. The new hotel will include 250 hotel rooms, 29,000 square feet of convention space, restaurants, and a sports bar. HBG Design was chosen to oversee the project, to cost about $250 million.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.visaliatimesdelta.com/story/news/2021/04/07/eagle-mountain-casino-breaks-ground-porterville/7126074002/ |title=Eagle Mountain Casino breaks ground in Porterville after years of planning |website=Visalia Times Delta |date=April 7, 2021 |first=Joshua |last=Yeager }}</ref> The new architecture is designed to reflect Tule River heritage, where "[[giant sequoia]]s and [[golden eagle]]s are tribal cultural symbols."<ref>{{cite web |url=https://kmph.com/news/local/eagle-mountain-casino-leaving-the-reservation-and-moving-to-town |title=Eagle Mountain Casino leaving the reservation and moving to town |website=kmph |date=April 6, 2021 |first=Rich |last=Rodriguez }}</ref> It was reported in April 2021 that the old casino building would be used as additional medical facilities.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.recorderonline.com/news/tule-river-tribe-introduces-design-construction-firms-for-casino/article_2b839630-9c79-11eb-80bd-e3f2c4317c79.html |title=Tule River Tribe introduces design, construction firms for casino |date=April 13, 2021 |website=RecorderOnline}}</ref>

The final beam was installed to a celebration in October 2021 in a [[topping out]] ceremony. The Tribal chairman noted the property had been purchased for the project in 1988. The new casino is a 100,000 square foot facility with 2,000 seats in the event center.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.recorderonline.com/gallery/eagle-mountain-beaming-over-pace-of-construction/article_6714c49e-3909-11ec-ae0a-17631756e497.html |title=Eagle Mountain 'beaming' over pace of construction |date=October 29, 2021 |website=The Recorder}}</ref> The Recorder Online in December 2021 published that the Tule River Tribe was at the time "able to maintain self-sufficiency largely in part to Eagle Mountain Casino." The tribe also stated that "with the Casino moving to a new location, even more members will be able to move to the reservation and more resources will be available to tribal members."<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.recorderonline.com/gallery/tule-river-elders-council-celebrates-sovereignty-with-flag-raising/article_e7880a5e-5f84-11ec-848c-f344c420e87e.html |title=Tule River Elders Council celebrates sovereignty with flag raising |date=Dec 17, 2021|website=Recorder Online}}</ref> 

Another reason for the relocation of the casino was the mountainous road needed to get to the reservation, occasionally subject to closure due to weather. The original casino shut down prematurely on March 11, 2023 due to the [[2022–2023 California floods]] and did not reopen prior to the inauguration of the new casino.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Tellez |first=Michael |date=2023-03-12 |title=Eagle Mountain Casino temporarily closed due to recent storms |url=https://kmph.com/news/local/tule-river-reservation-road-leading-flood-damage-dangers-flooding-waters-evacuated-tribe-neil-peyron-chairman-eagle-mountain-casino-temporarily-closed-due-to-recent-storms |access-date=2023-10-09 |website=KMPH |language=en}}</ref>

The new casino had a soft opening on April 17, 2023,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-05-06 |title=First look inside new Eagle Mountain Casino ahead of grand opening |url=https://abc30.com/eagle-mountain-casino-grand-opening-first-look-table-games/13216953/ |access-date=2023-10-09 |website=ABC30 Fresno |language=en}}</ref> with a full opening on May 9, 2023. The casino employs approximately 1,000 employees.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-05-09 |title=New and improved Eagle Mountain Casino officially open |url=https://abc30.com/eagle-mountain-casino-officially-open-new-slot-machines-table-games/13227514/ |access-date=2023-10-09 |website=ABC30 Fresno |language=en}}</ref>

==Entertainment==
A "[[mediumship|medium]]," [[Tyler Henry]], performed in Feb 2022 at the casino.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://kmph.com/news/entertainment/talking-to-hollywood-medium-tyler-henry-coming-to-eagle-mountain-casino |title=Talking to Hollywood Medium Tyler Henry coming to Eagle Mountain Casino |date=Feb 11, 2022 |website=KMPH}}</ref> He had been preceded that fall by [[Dwight Yoakam]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bakersfield.com/entertainment/music/dwight-yoakam-to-play-eagle-mountain-casino-on-oct-29/article_3281190c-20cd-11ec-82f0-fffeb826dc6e.html |title= Dwight Yoakam to play Eagle Mountain Casino on Oct. 29|date=Sep 28, 2021 |website=Bakersfield.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://kmph.com/news/local/dwight-yoakam-set-to-take-the-eagle-mountain-casino-stage-this-october |title= Dwight Yoakam set to take the Eagle Mountain Casino stage this October|date= 21 September 2021|website=KMPH}}</ref>

==Casino==
The new casino size is 100,000 square feet, with 1,750 slot machines and 20 table games. Unlike the previous casino, which did not serve alcohol, the new facility serves alcohol on the floor. The minimum gambling age was raised to 21 as a result.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2023-04-17 |title=Eagle Mountain Casino's new location opens May 9 in Porterville |url=https://kmph.com/news/local/eagle-mountain-casinos-new-location-opens-may-9-in-porterville |access-date=2023-10-09 |website=KMPH |language=en}}</ref> The previous casino was converted to tribal offices and schools, with some restaurant facilities remaining to provide food service to tribal residents.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Dillard |first=Gabriel |date=2023-05-22 |title=Eagle Mountain casino celebrates grand opening; tribe unveils new plans |url=https://thebusinessjournal.com/eagle-mountain-casino-celebrates-grand-opening-tribe-unveils-new-plans/ |access-date=2023-10-09 |website=The Business Journal |language=en-US}}</ref>
